latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ocli-api

- Launches ocli-api for turning any OpenAPI/Swagger API into CLI commands.
- Enables endpoint search using BM25 or regex queries.
- Supports checking command parameters and executing API calls directly from the CLI.
- No MCP server or code generation required; minimal token usage.
- Includes guardrails and troubleshooting guidance for common errors.
